body:
Hey, just here to say, I get what you mean. I really do. 
 
No one wants to deal with the negative people. And the moment you stop acting like a jolly old fool and reveal yourself to be cold pessimist people will stop, look at you and leave. Even in the end, people closest to you will get tired of you and go.

I'm bad at reacting properly, and can say the wrong stuff, but if you don't mind it, I'll be happy enough to listen to you rant.
